reviews.title: Watching ads for 15 min of vpn ???
reviews.text: I have used better, not for many many years, probably at least seven. It was pretty good, and then sometimes there will be ads that would began when I wanted to connect to the VPN, but I would watch the ad and then I could connect to the VPN for however long I wanted to. I made the mistake of updating this app and now I cannot get more than 15 minutes of this VPN without having to watch an ad? Absolutely ridiculous. I am deleting this app right away. I was fine with watching a single ad, but if you want me to watch an ad for 15 minutes of a VPN, you are out of your mind. IDK if it’s the devs or the business side of this company, but this is a big mistake. There’s so many other VPN apps out there that do not make their users go through this __. I am deleting the app now and finding a much better one, and I suggest other users to do the same.

reviews.title: No Longer a Free Option
reviews.text:
App just pushed a required update that makes the “free option” impossible. Not only did they increase the amount of ads you must watch, increased playback time for each ad, and remove the skip option, but now you are only allotted 15 minutes of VPN access per ad watch session. I tried this method and my ads stopped playing halfway through, so I couldn’t even get the 15 minute “reward.” I’ve used this specific VPN for years, but I won’t stick with a company that has that must disregard for their users.

I’m hoping that the next update will correct the problems and make the ad-watch-to-use option available and viable again. Until then, I’d recommend finding a better VPN.

reviews.text: I’m unsure if this was recently added, I’m assuming so… This app was very nice, worked well compared to other VPNs I used. Now, it’s limit to 15 minutes, which when I have watched ADs in order to get the 15 minutes, it won’t let me exit out of the ADs so I’m stuck… I can’t use it even if I wanted to. I’m unsure if it’s a bug with the ADs but I dislike the 15 minutes limit. Too many VPNs offer unlimited time as long as there’s an AD pop up randomly… If anyone is willing to pay for a VPN, I’d definitely suggest BetterNet. Otherwise, there’s easier accessing VPNs elsewhere for people who do not pay the subscription…
